title: geranium pyrenaicum var. lusitanicum
intro: Geranium pyrenaicum var. lusitanicum, commonly known as the Portuguese cranesbill, is a perennial herbaceous plant within the Geranium genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Portuguese cranesbill are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
